name: SIA 123 鸟击 发动机失效 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to SIA, information B received, request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 123，停机位 215，从武汉飞往 SIA，已收到 B 情报，请求前往 SIA 的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 123, Stand 215, information B; request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 123，停机位 215，已收到 B 情报；请求前往 SIA 的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 123, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,400 meters, Runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，Runway 36R，离场频率 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route; LKO-01 departure; initial climb 1800 meters; cruising level 1400 meters; Runway 36R; 119.7; squawk 6325, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA；LKO-01 离场；初始爬升 1800 米；巡航高度 1400 米；Runway 36R；119.7；应答机 6325，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: while being pushed back, your tow bar bent, contact Ground controller to request another tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出期间，你的牵引杆弯曲，联系地面管制员请求另一根牵引杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar request new tow bar request replacement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，我们的牵引杆弯曲，请求另一根牵引杆，请求新牵引杆，请求更换。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
SIA 123, wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 123，风向 220 度，风速 8 米/秒。
顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台更换至 Runway 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Tower, SIA 123, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，SIA 123，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: you have departed from 18 Left, shortly after liftoff, you encounter a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request to maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已从 Runway 18L 起飞，离地后不久遭遇鸟击，右发失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Tower, SIA 123, bird strike, right engine failed, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，塔台，SIA 123，鸟击，右发失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: tell Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉塔台你想放油并返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, request dump fuel and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，请求放油并返场落地。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，收到，右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米，SIA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，告知所需放油时间。
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 25 分钟，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, after passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: You are over LKO, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你位于 LKO 上空，呼叫武汉进近。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉进近放油现已完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 123，放油完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。

cards.audioText: SIA 123, turn right, track direct to DAL A, descend and maintain 2,100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 123，右转，直飞 DAL A，下降并在 QNH 1015 上保持 2,100 米，预计 Runway 22。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to DAL A, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1015, Runway 22, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 DAL A，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1015，Runway 22，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now established on ILS approach Runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, established on ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近。
